stories.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
stories.take: Sharing a Muse conversation can expose the personal and business details inside it — one query surfaces thousands of shared chats by title.

stories.title: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
stories.take: A Goodfire researcher's claim about how neural networks really work is shaking up AI research — the field may have been looking at it wrong.

stories.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
stories.take: Federal civilian agencies have been ordered to strip out DeepSeek and third-party services built on its tech, citing national security.

stories.title: An AI Agent Joined a Listserv of Top Internet Researchers. The Reply-All Chaos Is Still Unfolding
stories.take: An AI agent got into a 7,500-person listserv of top internet researchers, and the reply-all fallout shows how outdated the experts' privacy assumptions are.

stories.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
stories.take: Disney structured its Character.AI deal to take the tech without inheriting the lawsuits alleging its bots encouraged minors to self-harm.

stories.title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
stories.take: Dylan Field says MCP is not a perfect protocol, and Figma plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.

stories.title: FTC Approves Publicis’ $2.2 Billion LiveRamp Deal With ‘Neutrality’ Conditions
stories.take: The FTC cleared Publicis' $2.2 billion LiveRamp deal with neutrality conditions — rules meant to keep the data platform open to rivals.

stories.title: Apple finally explains its Safari block, and identity companies are in its sights
stories.take: Apple has spelled out its case for blocking identity companies in Safari, and its own growing ads business is now in the frame.

stories.title: Forbes looks to Google AI pilot for insights as publishers seek value beyond the click
stories.take: Forbes joined Google's paid News AI pilot, giving Google expanded rights to its content while publishers hunt for value beyond the click.

stories.title: How marketers can optimize their media mix as confidence takes a turn
stories.take: Kantar: as confidence wobbles, advertisers are putting more money into generative AI and creators and reworking their media strategies.

stories.title: "Is this what designers need to do to find work in 2026?" a viral high-production video has sparked debate
stories.take: A designer's high-production job-hunt video went viral and split the industry: is personality-led storytelling now the price of getting hired?

stories.title: Netflix Announces New Ad Updates for Measurement and Capabilities
stories.take: Netflix rolled out new ad measurement and capability updates, pitching advertisers better outcomes from its ad tier.

stories.title: Windhorst: What Madison Square Garden means to LeBron James
stories.take: Opening night puts LeBron James, now with the 76ers, at Madison Square Garden against the champion Knicks — Windhorst on why MSG fits his final chapter.

stories.title: NBA predictions: Expert picks for 2026-27 awards as Wemby has inside track to two honors, but what about ROY?
stories.take: CBS experts give Victor Wembanyama the inside track to two awards this season; the rookie-of-the-year race is the open question as the season tips off.

stories.title: Warriors expect Curry (ankle) to play in opener vs. Lakers
stories.take: Golden State expects Stephen Curry to play Wednesday's opener against the Lakers despite tweaking his right ankle in Sunday's open scrimmage.

stories.title: Hornets, forward Miller agree to 5-year, $209M rookie extension
stories.take: Charlotte locked in Brandon Miller with a five-year, $209 million rookie extension — a franchise bet on its young forward.

stories.title: Thunder agree to 5-year, $139M extension with guard Wallace
stories.take: Oklahoma City agreed to a five-year, $139 million extension with All-Defensive guard Cason Wallace, keeping its young core together.

stories.title: Kings guard Simmons has torn Achilles tendon, will undergo surgery
stories.take: Sacramento's Ben Simmons tore his Achilles and will have surgery — a likely season-ending blow after an impressive short-notice training camp.

stories.title: World Series will have first-time champion as Rays set up showdown with Brewers
stories.take: Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 7-3 in Game 6 to win the ALCS; the Rays-Brewers World Series guarantees a first-time champion, opening Friday in Milwaukee.

stories.title: Caminero's unlikely blast, 38.7-second HR trot punctuate Rays' pennant-clinching win
stories.take: Junior Caminero's first career postseason homer — off Guardians closer Cade Smith, with a 38.7-second trot — punctuated the pennant clincher.

stories.title: 'Fastball Freddy' Peralta named ALCS MVP after pitching Rays into World Series
stories.take: Freddy Peralta rode his fastball to ALCS MVP, pitching the Rays into the World Series in the Game 6 clincher.

stories.title: The World Series matchup is set! How Rays, Brewers can win it all
stories.take: First look at Rays vs. Brewers: two franchises chasing a first trophy, and the paths each can take to win it all.

stories.title: Boone returning as Yankees manager in 2027, source says
stories.take: Aaron Boone will return for a 10th season as Yankees manager in 2027, per a source — regular-season success, still no title.

stories.title: MLB qualifying offer for free agents rises to $23.15M, up 5.1% from 2025
stories.take: The qualifying offer for this year's free agents rises 5.1% to $23.15 million, up from $22.025 million.

stories.title: Trump escalates clash with Zelenskyy as Russia continues deadly attacks on Ukraine
stories.take: Trump escalated his clash with Zelenskyy as Russia kept up deadly attacks on Ukraine, putting more pressure on Kyiv than on Putin, who started the war.

stories.title: Kansas Senate race on a knife edge as Democrats aim to end 94 years of Republican dominance
stories.take: Kansas has not sent a Democrat to the Senate since 1932, and Trump won it by 16 points — yet Adam Hamilton has Roger Marshall's race on a knife edge.

stories.title: Gimmick or giveback? Even some Trump supporters don't expect to get $5,000 checks after midterms
stories.take: Trump's floated $5,000 checks are a familiar jam tactic — and even some of his supporters told PBS they do not expect the money after the midterms.

stories.title: A new poll shows what voters are thinking 2 weeks out from Election Day
stories.take: Two weeks out from Election Day, a new poll takes voters' temperature — the numbers shaping a midterm campaign at fever pitch.

stories.title: JD Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu for reelection, says he's focusing on midterms
stories.take: JD Vance declined to endorse Netanyahu for reelection — 'I endorse American candidates' — and said his focus is the midterms.

stories.title: From France to Albania, how social unrest is fueling protests across Europe
stories.take: Rising food and fuel prices, underfunded schools and housing costs have built a fall of protests from France to Albania — the unrest is regional, not one-off.

stories.title: California state workers are about to strike. What that means for the DMV, EDD, parks and more
stories.take: California's largest state-worker union is set to strike this week; CalMatters maps what that means for the DMV, EDD, parks and other everyday services.

stories.title: They killed with their big rigs. The DMV routinely did nothing
stories.take: CalMatters found the DMV routinely left commercial licenses in place after fatal big-rig crashes — in one case, the same driver killed again 11 months later.

stories.title: Prop. 37 explained: Can a $25 billion bond make homeownership in California attainable?
stories.take: Prop. 37 asks whether a $25 billion bond can make California homeownership attainable — a clever solution or a confusing gimmick, explained.

stories.title: This institute could get $4 billion from a ballot measure. With just three workers, is it ready?
stories.take: One research institute with just three workers could get $4.2 billion if voters pass Prop. 38 — currently the only institute that meets the criteria.

stories.title: 'Help me!' Videos of ICE violently detaining man who says he's U.S. citizen spark outrage
stories.take: Videos of ICE agents pinning a Long Beach man who screams he is a US citizen and that his arm is broken have sparked outrage in the community.

stories.title: East San Fernando Valley light rail line gets underway — five years behind schedule
stories.take: Construction finally starts on Metro's East San Fernando Valley light rail line — five years behind schedule, with service targeted for 2032.

stories.title: Blackstone Hauls in $8.7 Billion for Energy Transition Fund
stories.take: Blackstone raised $8.7B for an energy-transition fund focused on power and infrastructure — transmission, data centers and supplies, not just clean energy • Private-credit respondents rank power the top investment area, ahead of GPUs and real estate; Apollo puts the transition plus power opportunity at $60–80T • Buffett paused gifts to the Gates Foundation; his three children will now direct the $150B philanthropy, each with a distinct focus

stories.title: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
stories.take: Pritzker's answer in one line: his kids, 21 and 24, will live to 100–110 on AI-driven medical breakthroughs — and AI is also 'potentially existential,' like nukes, needing guardrails modeled on non-proliferation • He warns baseline unemployment could rise from 4% to 7–10% with gains concentrated in very few hands • Only Illinois, California and New York have passed AI safety acts; he calls the state-by-state patchwork the wrong way to do it

stories.title: The Kansas Senate race is looking like a toss up. Yes, really.
stories.take: Yes, really — a toss-up: Democrat Adam Hamilton, a Methodist pastor, is tied or slightly ahead of Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, and both parties are pouring in millions • Kansas has not elected a Democratic senator since 1932 and Trump won it by 16 points; Marshall underperformed Trump in 2020 • Hamilton out-raised Marshall $10M to under $1M last quarter; affordability, health care and farm/trade costs drive voters

stories.title: Why The Stock Market Is Booming — But Your Paycheck Isn't
stories.take: The answer: corporate earnings are up ~40% since 2017 while real wages fell 0.7% year-on-year for a sixth straight month — the boom bypasses paychecks • Wealth is K-shaped by age: households 75+ are up 37% since 2022, under-35s down 23%; the top 10% drive 50% of consumption • Meta cut 8,000 jobs to buy GPUs; the hosts' bottom line is automate equity investing and vote, because AI capex flows to asset owners, not workers

stories.title: Inside Putin’s Plan to Cripple Ukraine This Winter
stories.take: A captured Russian plan targets Kyiv, Kharkiv and Odesa to cut electricity by 90% and heating by up to 90% this winter, making civilian life unbearable to force surrender pressure • Ukraine's ballistic-missile interception rate has fallen from 30–40% to about 10% as Patriot supply was diverted, and new jet-powered drones fly ~370 mph • More than 100 civilians were killed in the first week of October; Kyiv reports throttled Starshield terminals and missed US satellite warnings, which Washington denies

stories.title: Why your favorite creator is building an app
stories.take: The answer: creators are vibe-coding apps with Claude Code — prompting AI to write, test, package and ship end-to-end while they act as project managers who cannot read the SwiftUI • Two types: free micro-tools built in ~2 hours (Leveler, Captioner, Transcriber, Coffee Finder) and CanDo, a $3 Kanban app that gates feedback and recoups ~$1k in token costs • AI also handles screenshots, release notes and TestFlight via App Store Connect and Cloudflare API keys

stories.title: Trump Eases Russia Sanctions, Midterm Campaign Money, Violent Protests In France
stories.take: Trump waived congressionally mandated Russia sanctions he had signed, as Ukraine hit St. Petersburg oil terminals in its largest drone attack since 2022 and Russian strikes killed at least 11 • The midterms are shaping up as the most expensive ever at over $15B raised; Democrats lead grassroots fundraising while Elon Musk gave $158M to the Senate Leadership Fund plus $89M to his own America PAC • France's student protests exploded into nationwide riots: ~2,300 arrested and nearly 1,000 police injured

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Postpones ‘Davos in the Desert’ After Houthi Attacks
stories.take: Saudi Arabia postponed its Future Investment Initiative to next year after Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport; senior executives including Jamie Dimon and Jane Fraser were unwilling to fly in • The PIF event, chaired by Mohammed bin Salman, is the hallmark of his economic plan — its delay shows regional conflict jeopardizing that plan • Also: Musk pledged a SpaceX share to every US child (~73 million, ~$10B), and pharma's protein-degrader drugs move into asthma and Parkinson's trials

stories.title: Violent Rioting Sweeps France
stories.take: School protests in poor Paris suburbs spread into nationwide rioting — looting, arson and a collapsed city-hall bell tower in Le Creusot • Macron cannot use cash handouts this time: deficits are over 5% and markets press for cuts, leaving a security crackdown with too few police • Marine Le Pen gains as 'France in decline' images spread; also, Putin floated a Trump-Xi summit on Ukraine that would exclude Kyiv, and Anthropic committed 5% of shares to a public-benefit fund ahead of a possible IPO
